title: Exact rotational moment certificates and a triangular-base tensor obstruction
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, implementation, tests and exposition, plus one separately tasked AI review. Not human peer review.
contribution_type: Independent exact verification and written construction refinement; non-Ramsey consequence conditional on source classification
claim: A centered isotropic constant planar base yields vanishing weighted zeroth and mixed derivative moments under rotations +theta,-theta,0 with weights 1,1,-2. The equilateral base gives diag(0,3,3) and a nine-point tensor-criterion obstruction 0=6.
assumptions: Characteristic-zero differential field; derivation fixes the base coordinates; sum q=0 and sum qq^T=cI with c nonzero.
Concrete example uses F=Q(sqrt(3),t), transcendental real 0<t<1/4, delta=(1+t^2)/2*d/dt.
Only the non-Ramsey implication inherits OpenAI classification Theorem thm:classification; it was not audited here.

verification.kind: Written proof plus exact symbolic rational-function identities
verification.independent_evidence: One nonconstant rational coefficient example and 36 symbolic pairwise distances; not unrestricted proof by sampling.
verification.reproduce: Install requirements-dev.txt, then python reproduce.py in the canonical source directory.

predecessors: OpenAI twelve-point square construction, classification claim and derivation-moment mechanism.
Pico/Hakon Amdal independent square checks and counterexample census.
Earlier Palvolgyi seven-point and derivation work credited by the source.
limitations: No claim of global novelty or a smallest non-Ramsey example.
Rational numerical substitutions do not support the required nonzero field derivation.
No verification of the classification theorem or arbitrary coloring quantifiers.
